Calculates the viewshed of one or more viewpoints on an elevation model: the cells visible from the viewpoints, with the number of viewpoints that see each cell. The cells not visible are no-data.

**Toolbox folder:** Geomorphology<br>
**Status:** Experimental<br>
**Keywords:** Viewshed, Visibility, Line of sight<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.Viewshed`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inRaster` | raster file |  |  | The elevation model. |
| `inViewPoints` | vector file |  |  | The vector of the viewpoints. |
| `pField` | String |  | `elev` | The field of the points with their height above the elevation model. |
| `pHeight` | double | m | `2.0` | The height of the viewpoints above the elevation model, used when the points have no height field. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outViewshed` | output file |  | The map of the number of viewpoints from which each cell is visible. |
